name: io.github.sharRahul/dcs-mcp
title: DCS World
description: Author and edit DCS World .miz missions offline, and control a running DCS through a bundled hook.

environmentVariables.name: DCS_SAVED_GAMES
environmentVariables.description: DCS Saved Games profile folder, if not Saved Games/DCS or DCS.openbeta

environmentVariables.name: DCS_INSTALL_DIR
environmentVariables.description: DCS install folder, scanned for unit mods (default: Program Files/Eagle Dynamics/DCS World*)

environmentVariables.name: DCS_MCP_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where session snapshots are kept ('off' disables them)

environmentVariables.name: DCS_ALLOW_RAW_LUA
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose dcs_execute_lua (also requires ALLOW_EXEC in the hook)
